name: Days with an inch or more of rain
title: Days with an inch or more of rain in {city}, {SS}
alt: Chart of days per month with at least one inch of rainfall in {city}, {SS}. {summary}
captions: {city}, {SS} averages about {total} a year with an inch or more of rain, most often in {peak}. Mould has a clock on it: material left wet beyond roughly 48 hours starts to grow, so what matters after a downpour is how fast it dries, not how much fell.
Heavy rain hits {city} around {total} a year, peaking in {peak}. A single inch overwhelms gutters and grading, and water that reaches a wall cavity is exactly the water nobody dries in time.
Roughly {total} of heavy rain fall on {city} each year. Each one is a chance for intrusion, and intrusion that is not dried within a couple of days is where remediation work begins.
